blockers: NegationClosure.lean:1712 (nf_exist_formula_nested_backward): The SOLE irreducible sorry. All other sorries on the Kamp chain cascade from this one. Requires either a composition lemma (approach A/B) or a formula redesign (approach C).

continuation_context.key_finding: Phases 1-2 (Prop 4.2 negation closure) are ALREADY sorry-free in existing code. The blocker is NOT Prop 4.2 itself but rather the WIRING from Prop 4.2 to NF existentials -- specifically, the backward direction of nf_exist_formula_nested which requires a composition argument for non-interval zones.
continuation_context.approach_recommendation: Approach (C) -- VecEA2-based formula -- is most promising. Instead of analyzing nf_exist_formula_nested backwards, construct the existential formula from scratch using VecEA2 types (which already have sorry-free translation and negation closure). The construction would be: for each quantifier condition, build a VecEA2 encoding the existential/universal condition, then use conjunction closure (sorry-free) and existential closure (sorry-free) to assemble. The correctness is BY CONSTRUCTION, avoiding backward analysis. The main challenge is encoding depth-k 3-var NF evaluation as VecEA2.holds conditions with two free variables (x and t), which requires extending VecEA2.holds from interval semantics to full NF semantics.
